rationale: Roberts is most likely to keep the opinion to a narrow, unanimous, text-focused venue holding that enforces § 7607(b)(1)’s local/national line and the “find and publish” prerequisite. Kagan and Gorsuch are the most likely separate writers—Kagan to stress administrability/uniformity concerns while agreeing the statute controls, and Gorsuch to emphasize anti-forum-shopping and separation-of-powers limits on agency-driven venue selection.
